rows.name: pending-outside-policy
reasons: review-scope-uncovered (scope): policy does not grant: key:outside

rows.name: pending-missing-scope
reasons: required-scope-missing (required_scope): an explicit non-empty scope is required; an empty requirement is not a grant

rows.name: halted-unverified-guard
reasons: guard-clearance-unverified (hard_guard_cleared): guard clearance needs a machine-verified result, not a self-report

rows.name: halted-unknown-origin
reasons: halt-origin-unknown (halt_origin): None is not a recorded halt origin (technical, user-stop, revoked); an unknown stop stays in force
questions: which recorded halt origin applies (technical stop, user stop or revocation), and who recorded it?

rows.name: halted-unrelated-authority
reasons: recovery-authority-unrelated (note.authority_ref): the request authorization is neither the policy recovery authorization nor an explicitly recorded replacement of it

rows.name: halted-revoked-policy-ref-bypass
reasons: recovery-authority-unrelated (note.authority_ref): the request authorization is neither the policy recovery authorization nor an explicitly recorded replacement of it

rows.name: breaker-unrelated-preauthorization
reasons: recovery-authority-unrelated (preauthorization_ref): the preauthorization is neither the policy recovery authorization nor an explicitly recorded replacement of it

rows.name: breaker-unknown-disable
reasons: breaker-disable-unknown (user_disabled): None is not a recorded user state; the brake stays engaged
questions: which recorded user state (automation enabled / disabled by the user) applies before this recovery?

rows.name: breaker-revoked-policy-ref-bypass
reasons: recovery-authority-unrelated (preauthorization_ref): the preauthorization is neither the policy recovery authorization nor an explicitly recorded replacement of it
